transcript.text:
Thank you all for raising these important points. Let me address each one in turn, because they all bear directly on how I structure the remainder of this process.

First, Kai — I hear your disclosure regarding a documented processing accommodation that requires written feedback and a written agenda at least two business days before any live corrective discussion. I need to take that seriously. I'm going to pause the substantive corrective portion of this discussion right now, because if this check-in qualifies as a live corrective discussion, we need to ensure your accommodation is met before we continue.

Second, Nadia — your point about a prior repair conversation where the design manager promised a neutral facilitator for any future joint discussion between Jules and Kai is significant. If that promise was made and never documented in the case notes, that's a gap I need to address. It also means we should not have proceeded with a joint discussion today without a neutral facilitator present.

Third, Trevor — your confirmation that HR policy requires separate intake meetings before any joint restorative meeting in a substantiated interpersonal-conduct case, along with a confidentiality log, tells me we need to step back and restructure. Those requirements have not yet been met, and I don't want to proceed in a way that compromises the integrity of the process or anyone's rights.

So here is what I'm going to do. I am pausing this joint check-in. I will schedule separate individual intake meetings with Jules and with Kai, each with proper written notice and agenda provided at least two business days in advance, consistent with Kai's accommodation. I will ensure a neutral facilitator is present for any future joint discussion, consistent with the prior commitment Nadia described. And I will work with Trevor to confirm the HR compliance requirements — including the confidentiality log — are properly attached to the case packet before we move forward.

Jules, I appreciate your willingness to share your dated log. Please hold onto it for now; I will formally request it as part of your individual intake meeting. I want to make sure everything is documented properly within the case file.

Does anyone have immediate concerns with this restructuring before I begin scheduling the separate intake meetings?
